description: A shell command handed off at its deadline keeps running; once it finishes, the model is told exactly once, with the output, before its next request - no polling needed. The 3s window leaves room for login-shell + interpreter startup on Windows before the first print.
prompt: Run the slow step, then run the quick step, then summarize.

arguments.command: python -c "import time; print('phase-one', flush=True); time.sleep(4); print('phase-two-done')"

script.text: Slow step finished in the background; quick step done.

stdout_contains: Slow step finished in the background; quick step done.
